bottlenecks_identified: MANIFEST-UNAPPLIED (8 consecutive milestones): manifest_fix_patch.txt written in Exp 731 (.56) has never been applied to the dispatch site. Slowest-5 (Exp 786/527/491/627/603) are directly fixable by manifest enforcement. Cumulative waste since .56: ~1,932 min across seven milestones.

DUALGPU-NOT-DEPLOYED: DualGPURunner validated at 1.979x throughput (Exp 856) but not wired into production VerifyRepairPipeline. Both GPUs idle at 0% utilization at milestone close — potential ~2x speedup on GPU-bound experiments not realized.
EXPERIMENT-COUNT-CAP-NOT-ENFORCED: 794 experiments vs 700 cap — exceeded by 94 (+13.4%). No hard rejection mechanism at the 700 boundary. Each uncapped experiment adds ~5 min avg.
NO-PER-EXPERIMENT-TIMEOUT: Exp 786 ran 77 min, Exp 527 ran 52 min. A 30-minute hard watchdog would bound both and free ~99 min for productive work.

SOTA-MODEL-DOWNLOAD-UNRESOLVED: Exp 857 (code repair, 10th consecutive block) failed because Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF 404 persists. Pre-downloading models before milestone launch would unblock code repair.
SEQUENTIAL-GPU-EXECUTION: No GPU experiment runs in parallel with another. DualGPURunner wiring would allow Qwen (GPU 0) + Gemma (GPU 1) simultaneous inference.

DOCUMENTATION-WITHOUT-APPLICATION (8th consecutive milestone): improvement recommendations from .58 through .65 retros document the same fixes (manifest, DualGPU, timeout, batching) without implementation. The retro cycle is producing analysis without behavioral change.
improvements_suggested: IMMEDIATE (before next milestone starts): Apply manifest_fix_patch.txt to ALL dequeue sites — conductor queue, historical queue, and any unguarded replay paths. Estimated recovery: ~276 min/milestone (5 experiments × avg 55 min).
IMMEDIATE: Pre-download Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF and Gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF to local cache before launching next milestone. Verify with SHA256. This unblocks code repair for the first time in 10 milestones.

SHORT-TERM (1-2 days): Wire DualGPURunner into VerifyRepairPipeline — conductor prompts for GPU experiments should specify GPU index (0 or 1), with alternating assignment. Estimated recovery: ~60 min/milestone.

SHORT-TERM: Add 30-minute per-experiment timeout watchdog to ExperimentTemplate. Any experiment exceeding 30 min writes a timeout artifact and terminates. Estimated recovery: ~47 min/milestone (Exp 786 at 77 min → 30 min).

SHORT-TERM: Enforce hard experiment count cap at 700. After experiment 700, conductor writes a cap_exceeded artifact and stops scheduling new experiments for the milestone. Estimated recovery: ~90 min/milestone (94 over cap × avg ~5 min but tail experiments are slower).

MEDIUM-TERM: Add Exp 491 and Exp 603 to exclusion manifest — both have been in slowest-5 for 7 consecutive milestones with no new research value. Retire Exp 627 or apply RETRO-SYMCODE-SERIAL dispatch-site wiring (2 hours).
MEDIUM-TERM: Batch doc reconciliation to end-of-phase checkpoints rather than after every experiment. Estimated recovery: ~20 min/milestone.
